Recorded claim:
Stream `POST /api/update-graphs` as NDJSON `{ type: "output", output }`, `{ type: "status", message }`, and final `{ type: "result", ... }`; `lib/utils.mjs` `onStdout`/`onStderr` plus Git `--progress` make live transport possible. Keep `.mach-output-panel` hidden while `.mach-output-toggle` remains available. Limit `attachGraphTryRunsToCommits` to four workers and cache immutable full-hash messages. [Task 1]
